description.en: Sets a temporary bit flag scoped to the current map (reset when the map is left/reloaded, unlike CMND_SET_TEMP_BIT_FLAG's session-wide scope), identified by a numeric bit index. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Index of the temporary map-scoped bit flag to set.
Optional value to set (defaults to true when omitted).

example.code:
// Mark a map-local flag for the duration of this map visit
CMND_SET_TEMP_MAP_BIT_FLAG(3, true);
